testEnvironment: Windows 10/11; Java 17; Maven Wrapper; JUnit 5; Mockito; JaCoCo; Google Sheets API.

methods.description: Partially update a class while enforcing lifecycle, permission, capacity, commercial-history and session-synchronization rules.
methods.preCondition: Class repositories, current user, audit log and ClassSessionScheduleService are mocked.

cases.scenario: The PATCH request contains no provided field.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown before the class row is locked.

cases.scenario: The client attempts to set a lifecycle status directly.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown and no class is saved.

cases.scenario: Capacity is reduced below the number of active trainees.
Price is changed after enrollment or payment history exists.
cases.expected: CONFLICT is thrown and no class is saved.

cases.scenario: A valid weekly schedule is changed for an upcoming class.
cases.expected: Definition is validated, class is saved, future sessions are synchronized and CLASS_UPDATED is audited.

cases.scenario: Updated dates move an upcoming class into the completed lifecycle.
cases.input: startDate and endDate are both in the past.
cases.expected: Status becomes COMPLETED; future sessions are deleted and are not rebuilt.

methods.description: Parse a weekly schedule, generate future sessions, detect trainer conflicts and reconcile saved sessions without rewriting history.
methods.preCondition: ClassSessionRepository is mocked; ObjectMapper is real; dates are generated relative to the execution day.

cases.scenario: The class has no weekly schedule JSON.
Two slots on the same day overlap.
cases.expected: INVALID_REQUEST is thrown before sessions are saved.

cases.scenario: The trainer already teaches another class at an overlapping time.
cases.input: Desired 09:00-10:00; existing 09:30-10:30 on the same date.

cases.scenario: A valid one-day schedule has no existing session or trainer conflict.
cases.expected: One ClassSession is saved with the class and trainer IDs.

cases.scenario: One future session still matches the schedule and another is stale.
cases.expected: The matching row receives the current trainer; the stale row is deleted.

methods.description: Build and classify the authenticated trainee's online-course and class progress from effective curriculum data.
methods.preCondition: Current user, enrollment, curriculum, progress and assignment dependencies are mocked.

cases.scenario: The trainee has no enrolled online course or class.
cases.expected: All totals are zero and all result lists are empty.

cases.scenario: An online course has one published and completed lesson.
cases.input: One online enrollment and one completed VIDEO lesson.
cases.expected: The course is 100% and appears in completedCourseItems.

cases.scenario: The trainee has one completed online course and one half-completed class.
cases.expected: Total=2, completed=1, in-progress=1 and class overall progress=50%.
